title: Mysterious Chest
text: How it works Every 4 hours 28 treasure chests spawn in Auroria. Interacting with these chests will either spawn a monster or give the player a tradepack worth 400g delivered to any ocean trader. The chance of getting the chest is about 1/25. The server broadcasts the tradepack's coordinates when spawned. Chests spawn in a general area, the map markers only roughly represent the area. The spawn timer resets every time the server restarts, and is usually several minutes before the announcement that the server is back up. Interactable treasure chest
html:
How it works

Every 4 hours 28 treasure chests spawn in Auroria. Interacting with these chests will either spawn a monster or give the player a tradepack worth 400g delivered to any ocean trader. The chance of getting the chest is about 1/25. The server broadcasts the tradepack's coordinates when spawned. Chests spawn in a general area, the map markers only roughly represent the area. The spawn timer resets every time the server restarts, and is usually several minutes before the announcement that the server is back up.
